Focus is on the paper edge and ribbon; any surface print is entirely out of focus and unreadable, never actual words or scripture. 16:9 cinematic composition, 85mm macro lens, f/2.8 shallow depth of field, exceptional photorealistic material detail, restrained analog film texture, rich but natural dynamic range.
